title: Dolly Zoom
description: A dolly zoom combines camera movement and opposite zooming to preserve subject size while distorting perspective. It is not a zoom with a digital background stretch: translation and focal length work against each other.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: The person appears fixed while the world becomes unreliable. Recognition, fear, or vertigo becomes a spatial event rather than merely a reaction close-up.
Use once; repeating it turns a contradiction into a trick. It is the wrong tool for a normal approach, and the wrong tool if subject size also changes.
If the crop simply grows, you zoomed. If the person grows and the room slides, you dollied.
The effect needs both, opposed.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Rehearse a dolly-in with zoom-out, or dolly-out with zoom-in. Match subject scale at both ends and coordinate focus.

Background perspective stretches or compresses while the chosen subject holds size. Prompt a dolly zoom: camera dollies while the lens counter-zooms so the figure stays the same size as the background warps.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it for a realization that the ground is not stable, and use it once. Concrete beat: a seated watcher understands the water is no longer safe, body size holds, beach warps.
Do not use it as a stylish walk-up.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: A Dolly In changes subject size and perspective together. A Slow Zoom In changes size without walking.
Dolly zoom holds size and breaks perspective. That opposition is the whole technique.

blocks.text: Vertigo looks down the bell-tower stairwell as space flexes. Jaws holds Brody's size on the beach while the background warps.
Goodfellas uses the diner talk near the end as a trap in stretched space. La Haine has a well-known rooftop cousin.
Geometry, not a face to copy.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Dolly zoom on [Subject], camera dollies in while the lens zooms out so the figure stays the same size as the background warps, vertigo spatial contradiction, sickly perspective stretch. For motion: dolly zoom on [Subject]: the camera dollies while the lens counter-zooms so the subject size holds and the background warps.

One continuous six-second shot of a station attendant realizing a train is missing. Dolly straight backward while optically zooming in at the compensating rate. Keep her head exactly the same height and centered; the long platform behind her appears to compress. She barely moves. Stable facial identity, rigid architecture, no cut, no ordinary push-in.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a Slow Zoom In or a background warp in post. The tell is a changing subject size, or a stretch with no camera travel.
The fix: opposite dolly and zoom, subject scale matched at both ends, perspective actually changing.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Dolly Zoom in film?
It is a simultaneous dolly and opposite zoom that keeps a subject roughly the same size while the surrounding perspective stretches or compresses.
Dolly Zoom vs Dolly In
Dolly in walks closer and the person grows. Dolly zoom walks and counter-zooms so the person holds while the world becomes geometrically untrustworthy.
When should I use Dolly Zoom?
When fear or recognition should happen in space itself. Use it once. Do not use it as a default push.
How do I prompt Dolly Zoom for AI image or video?
Write dolly in while zooming out (or the reverse), subject size constant, background warping. Ban a digital stretch without camera travel.
